maya: Quick heads-up — before we flip q4b on the new model, we need a dedupe + kvcache short-prefix smokecheck on the longprompt promptbank. Please pause edits in promptbank/longforms until we snapshot. tagging @jordan @vikram

vikram: Ack. Pausing edits. Can you paste the dedupe command?

maya: Run locally:
```bash
./tools/dedupe --db promptbank --scope longforms --minhash 0.78 --kvcache-prefix 32 --dry-run
```
Seeing a handful of near-duplicates flagged that look like legitimate paraphrases. sample output:
```
ID 12345 -> 12349 score 0.81 (keep 12345)
ID 23456 -> 23460 score 0.79 (potential false pos)
```

jordan: These two are suspicious — I think kvcache-prefix 32 is too short for mixed-length prompts. short-prefix collisions for longctx are common. can we try prefix 48?

sophia: Also noticed dedupe is removing prompts with code blocks; tokenizers compress code to similar hashes. we should add a rule to ignore fenced code for dedupe.

labeler-bot: FYI: label queues (curation-longforms) will auto-reassign after freeze. paused 14 tasks.

maya: Plan:
1) snapshot promptbank longforms to refset/ref-2026-03-21
2) run dedupe with prefix=48 + ignore-code rule
3) run small relabel batch of 200 examples for manual review
4) update golden_ref with stable IDs and roll to quant-bench.
Who's owning relabel?

vikram: I can own relabel. will spin up 200 job and add a short rubric.

jordan: I'll run dedupe with the new params and post the diff. expecting ~1.3% removal vs 2.8% before.

sophia: can we add a quick eval: run both pre/dedupe banks through the q4b-int4 quant sim and compute hallucination and rouge? I can script.

maya: Yes — target: <1% delta on hallucination score, <0.5 pt ROUGE drop. if beyond that we fallback to hybrid routing.

labeler-bot: relabel job created: job-7890, assigned to vikram, due EOD tomorrow.

jordan: posting diff now: https://internal/redwood/diffs/1711112222/dedupe-run — early look: 68 false positives flagged; attaching examples in thread.

maya: Thanks. once relabel done, we tag golden as "stable-ref-2026-03-21-kv48-ignorecode" and schedule small canary of 1000 requests against q4b-int4.

sophia: Noted — I'll prepare canary harness and perf monitors. will also add a quick metric: prefix-collision-rate.

maya: Perfect. leaving freeze in place until we close thread. :thumbsup:
